title: the_route_he_stole
display_title: My best friend stole my parkour route and got sponsored for it
beats: My best friend (19M) uploaded my exact parkour route frame by frame and called it his own creation.
I'd spent three months building that course in secret, testing every jump until my hands cramped.
He was the only person I ever showed it to, because I trusted him more than anyone.
The video blew up, a server sponsor reached out, and he never once said my name.
I messaged him the timestamp proving I recorded it two months earlier, and he left me on read.
Yesterday he posted a photo captioned 'grateful for where hard work takes you,' tagged at the sponsor's event.
Was I wrong to screenshot everything and send it to the sponsor myself?
